# Offline fixtures

`tiny/` contains a nine-node bidirectional GraphML road path with speed tags and a 3 × 3 population-count GeoTIFF (cell values 1–9, total 45). These are synthetic software fixtures in EPSG:32644, not a real city or calibrated population/hazard dataset.

The fixtures are generated by `tests.helpers.small_inputs.raster_fixture` and `cell_graph(cells=9)`, with 40 km/h `maxspeed` tags. XML, boundary, nodata and invalid-input variants are built in temporary directories by the tests.

Run the small example from the repository root:

```sh
georesilience run tests/fixtures/tiny --out /tmp/georesilience-demo --no-figures --jobs 2 --connectivity-samples 64 --travel-time-samples 64
```
